sources.fullCitation: Deutsche Nationalbibliothek, GND 1061685829, “Péguy, Robert”, director, born 14 December 1883 and died 21 July 1968; variant forms “Péguy, Marcel Robert” and “Robert, Marcel”. Library of Congress heading no2009019373, “Péguy, Robert, 1883-1968”. Accessed 1 August 2026.
sources.researchNote: The French Wikipedia article gives the birth name as Marcel Robert Péguy and locates both his birth and death in the 17th arrondissement of Paris. Neither authority file records the spelling Pégy; the GND links directly to the filmportal.de record for the same man. The form printed in the credits of Son altesse l'amour is therefore treated as a source-specific spelling rather than as a name he is known to have used elsewhere.

personNameVariants.publicNote: Spelling used by filmportal.de in the credits for “Son altesse l'amour”. No authority file records it. The GND entry for Péguy links to filmportal's record for the same director, indicating that the missing u is a transcription in one credit record rather than a working name.
